info.description: Updates the identity provider configuration for the fleet.
info.title: Amazon WorkLink

requests.description: Specifies a domain to be associated to Amazon WorkLink.
requests.name: POST /associateDomain
requests.note: Replace {{AMAZON_WORKLINK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Associates a website authorization provider with a specified fleet. This is used to authorize users against associated websites in the company network.
requests.name: POST /associateWebsiteAuthorizationProvider
requests.note: Replace {{AMAZON_WORKLINK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Imports the root certificate of a certificate authority (CA) used to obtain TLS certificates used by associated websites within the company network.
requests.name: POST /associateWebsiteCertificateAuthority
requests.note: Replace {{AMAZON_WORKLINK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates a fleet. A fleet consists of resources and the configuration that delivers associated websites to authorized users who download and set up the Amazon WorkLink app.
requests.name: POST /createFleet
requests.note: Replace {{AMAZON_WORKLINK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes a fleet. Prevents users from accessing previously associated websites.
requests.name: POST /deleteFleet
requests.note: Replace {{AMAZON_WORKLINK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Describes the configuration for delivering audit streams to the customer account.
requests.name: POST /describeAuditStreamConfiguration
requests.note: Replace {{AMAZON_WORKLINK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Describes the networking configuration to access the internal websites associated with the specified fleet.
requests.name: POST /describeCompanyNetworkConfiguration
requests.note: Replace {{AMAZON_WORKLINK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Provides information about a user's device.
requests.name: POST /describeDevice
requests.note: Replace {{AMAZON_WORKLINK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Describes the device policy configuration for the specified fleet.
requests.name: POST /describeDevicePolicyConfiguration
requests.note: Replace {{AMAZON_WORKLINK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Provides information about the domain.
requests.name: POST /describeDomain
requests.note: Replace {{AMAZON_WORKLINK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Provides basic information for the specified fleet, excluding identity provider, networking, and device configuration details.
requests.name: POST /describeFleetMetadata
requests.note: Replace {{AMAZON_WORKLINK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Describes the identity provider configuration of the specified fleet.
requests.name: POST /describeIdentityProviderConfiguration
requests.note: Replace {{AMAZON_WORKLINK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Provides information about the certificate authority.
requests.name: POST /describeWebsiteCertificateAuthority
requests.note: Replace {{AMAZON_WORKLINK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Disassociates a domain from Amazon WorkLink. End users lose the ability to access the domain with Amazon WorkLink.
requests.name: POST /disassociateDomain
requests.note: Replace {{AMAZON_WORKLINK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Disassociates a website authorization provider from a specified fleet. After the disassociation, users can't load any associated websites that require this authorization provider.
requests.name: POST /disassociateWebsiteAuthorizationProvider
requests.note: Replace {{AMAZON_WORKLINK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Removes a certificate authority (CA).
requests.name: POST /disassociateWebsiteCertificateAuthority
requests.note: Replace {{AMAZON_WORKLINK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Retrieves a list of devices registered with the specified fleet.
requests.name: POST /listDevices
requests.note: Replace {{AMAZON_WORKLINK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Retrieves a list of domains associated to a specified fleet.
requests.name: POST /listDomains
requests.note: Replace {{AMAZON_WORKLINK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Retrieves a list of fleets for the current account and Region.

requests.note: Replace {{AMAZON_WORKLINK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Retrieves a list of tags for the specified resource.

requests.description: Adds or overwrites one or more tags for the specified resource, such as a fleet. Each tag consists of a key and an optional value. If a resource already has a tag with the same key, this operation updates its value.
requests.name: POST /tags/{ResourceArn}
requests.note: Replace {{AMAZON_WORKLINK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Retrieves a list of website authorization providers associated with a specified fleet.

requests.note: Replace {{AMAZON_WORKLINK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Signs the user out from all of their devices. The user can sign in again if they have valid credentials.
